name: Baked BBQ Salmon with Cajun Spiced Broccoli, Bell Pepper & Rice (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium food storage containers.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cups vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat salmon dry with paper towels. Place on the baking sheet and spread barbecue sauce over top. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g salmon fillet
¼ cup barbecue sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to another baking sheet, along with broccoli. Drizzle veggies with oil, then sprinkle with Cajun seasoning and salt. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (510 g) bag broccoli florets
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Cajun seasoning
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until veggies are fork-tender and salmon is cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Divide rice, veggies, and salmon between storage containers. Set aside to cool completely, about 30 minutes, then cover and refrigerate until ready to eat. Reheat in an oven or microwave and enjoy!
